headline: The thirteen bot tasks 0099A170 builds are all aircraft tasks, and none of them issues a unit command. Each factory is an operator_new wrapper around one constructor of a common family: base 0099C6F0 at [0,3F8h) holding the kind id at +300h and the current state pointer at +310h, an approach controller from 009F9CE0 at +3F8h holding the unit, its class block, the pilot control block at unit+9D4h and a speed ratio at +41Ch, then per-class state objects named moveto/follow plus a class-specific attack chain. The per-tick rule is vtable slot +54h: it writes Pilot/<Class>/CruisingAlt and a second altitude into the pilot control block and clamps an attack distance scaled by the speed ratio. Break-off is slot +1Ch: no target, a target marked at +5Dh, or distance past Pilot/<Class>/SafeDist times the speed ratio.
